name: structural-toolbox
title: Structural Toolbox
description: Section and material libraries, stress and torsion calculators, buckling factors, and linear 2D beam, frame and truss analysis.
author: lk1224_p

commands.name: structures
commands.title: Structures
commands.description: Quick beam, section, stress, torsion and buckling-factor calculations with equations and visualizations.

commands.name: library
commands.title: Library
commands.description: Browse materials and sections in one place.

commands.name: guide
commands.title: Guide
commands.description: Examples, units, modelling assumptions and library editing.

preferences.name: libraryDirectory
preferences.title: Custom CSV Library Folder (Optional)
preferences.description: One folder can contain multiple materials and sections CSVs. Leave blank for the automatic personal folder; Library → CSV Files shows the active path and loaded files.

preferences.name: defaultMaterial
preferences.title: Default Material
preferences.description: Material ID used as a visible suggestion, such as C24, GL24h or Steel-S355.

preferences.name: precision
preferences.title: Result Precision
preferences.description: Decimal places used in calculation results.

preferences.name: diagramTextSize
preferences.title: Diagram Text Size
preferences.description: Readable diagram labels, reactions, stress values and equations. Larger sizes use more vertical space.
